detail.title: Deepening the Neurodiversity vs. Pathology Inquiry
detail.summary: The research continues under the enforced neurodivergence topic. The objective is to gather initial comparative literature that explicitly addresses the conceptual tension between the neurodiversity paradigm and traditional clinical pathology models, establishing a baseline for future synthesis.
